HEADER: Init +3; Senses Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +12
DEFENSE: AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+3 armor, +3 Dex, +2 natural, -1 size)
Defensive Abilities Natural Armor; Resist earth 5
OFFENSE: Special Abilities Improved Quarry (move action or while charging), Quarry
STATISTICS: Str 19, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 10, Wis 16, Cha 8
Base Atk +4; CMB +9; CMD 22 (26 vs. trip)
Feats Alertness*, Boon Companion, Precise Shot*, Weapon Focus (Longbow)
Skills Acrobatics +9, Knowledge (Nature) +7, Perception +12, Sense Motive +5, Survival +10 (+12 track)
SQ Alertness, Beastmaster Tricks (Tangling Attack), Fast, Favored Enemy (Humanoid (Hume) +2), Natural Mount, Ranger Combat Training (Precise Shot), Ranger's Bond (wolf), Track, Undersized Weapons
Gear cure potion (2), greataxe, composite longbow [+4 Str], 20 arrows, hide shirt
SPECIAL ABILITIES: Fast (ex) Centaurs gain a 10-foot racial bonus to their speed.
Natural Armor (ex) Centaurs have tough skin, granting them a +2 natural armor bonus.

Natural Mount (ex) A centaur counts as having the Mounted Combat feat only for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisites, and substitutes the Acrobatic skill for any Ride skill prerequisites when acquiring feats that have Mounted Combat as a prerequisite. Because of his equine form, a centaur can wield a lance one-handed as if mounted and deals double damage with a lance while charging. A centaur can never gain the benefit of the Mounted Combat feat (or other similar feats or effects, such as Trick Riding) if ridden by another creature.

Undersized Weapons (ex) Although a centaur is Large, its upper torso is the same size as that of a Medium humanoid. As a result, they wield weapons as if they were one size category smaller than their actual size (Medium for most centaurs).

curation.summary: Centaur Ranger is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 32 generated item(s) across 9 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
